title: feat(gen): publish the polli skill via Agent Skills well-known discovery
author: Drjacky

gist.summary: Added Agent Skills Discovery RFC v0.2.0 endpoints to gen.pollinations.ai: `/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json` lists the `polli` skill with its description and a `sha256:` digest of the served bytes, while `/.well-known/agent-skills/polli/SKILL.md` serves the skill as Markdown. The index is linked from `llms.txt`, so agents can find it through either discovery path. Both skill URLs use `packages/polli-cli/SKILL.md` as their source; the index name and description come from its front matter, and the digest is computed once per isolate. No skill content changed.
